description: This file defines the 'License' entity class for ORM mapping in a Human Resource Management system. It includes properties for 'id' and 'name', and maintains a collection of related 'EmployeeLicense' entities. The class is annotated for Doctrine ORM, indicating it's used for database persistence.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Entity class representing a license with an ID, name, and associated employee licenses. Mapped to the 'ohrm_license' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the license.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the license.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the license.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the license.
